stories.excerpt: Veritasium's viral deep-dive into how electricity really moves through circuits sparked a months-long debate among physicists and engineers — challenging a model taught in every introductory physics class.

stories.headline: AI Safety Researchers on Bluesky Form Working Group for Open Evaluation Standards
stories.excerpt: A coalition of AI safety researchers announced on Bluesky the formation of an open working group to develop standardized evaluation benchmarks for model safety. The initiative aims to create reproducible, community-driven safety testing that any lab can adopt.

stories.headline: BepiColombo Enters Mercury Orbit After Seven-Year Journey, Begins Surface Mapping
stories.excerpt: The joint ESA-JAXA BepiColombo mission successfully entered orbit around Mercury after a seven-year interplanetary cruise. The spacecraft's two orbiters will spend at least one year mapping Mercury's surface, magnetic field, and exosphere, providing the most detailed study of the solar system's innermost planet to date.

stories.headline: Warsh's Five Fed Task Forces Signal Structural Overhaul of Monetary Policy Operations
stories.excerpt: New Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's creation of five internal Task Forces — covering communications, the balance sheet, data sources, productivity and jobs, and the inflation framework — signals the most significant restructuring of Fed operations in decades. Each task force will report recommendations before year-end.
stories.licenceBasis: Federal Reserve public domain — official minutes and statements

stories.headline: Adobe Breached Via Indian BPO Firm: Threat Actor 'Mr. Raccoon' Used Phishing to Reach Helpdesk
stories.excerpt: A threat actor known as 'Mr. Raccoon' allegedly breached Adobe through an Indian Business Process Outsourcing firm, delivering a Remote Access Tool via targeted phishing emails to reach the helpdesk environment. The incident highlights growing supply-chain attack vectors through third-party service providers.

stories.headline: Anthropic Ships Claude Agent SDK With TypeScript and Python Tools for Production Agent Systems
stories.excerpt: Anthropic released the Claude Agent SDK, providing specialized TypeScript and Python tooling designed to integrate Claude models into production agent systems. The SDK includes built-in support for tool use orchestration, multi-step reasoning, and structured output, lowering the barrier for developers building autonomous AI workflows.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: 721 Ransomware Victims Recorded in June Alone as Attack Pace Remains Elevated
stories.excerpt: Cybersecurity monitoring firms recorded 721 publicly disclosed ransomware victims globally in June 2026, continuing the elevated attack pace that has defined the year. The United States remained the single most-targeted country, with healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure sectors bearing the heaviest impact.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from NVD and cybersecurity industry reports

stories.headline: Japan's MMX Mission Launches for Martian Moon Phobos to Collect First-Ever Samples
stories.excerpt: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency launched its Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission, sending a spacecraft on a multi-year journey to the Martian moon Phobos. The mission aims to land on Phobos, collect surface samples, and return them to Earth — a feat never before attempted at Mars.

stories.headline: Ireland Closes Its Last Coal Plant, Joining Growing List of Coal-Free Nations
stories.excerpt: Ireland officially closed its last remaining coal-fired power station, becoming one of a growing number of nations to fully exit coal-based electricity generation. The closure is part of Ireland's broader commitment to reach 80% renewable electricity by 2030.
